maria-cs: Starting coordination for Dynamo reserved capacity prep ahead of renewal. Need an ops-friendly priming plan, autoscale knobs, and a short soak. Thinking Tue 10:00 PT. Can we lock pool and a short rollback window?
raj-eng: I can allocate cluster 'pool-42' (4x A100). Need expected qps/tokens and p95 target to size warm priming. Also will confirm customer IP allowlist.
maria-cs: Target steady 110 qps, ~450 tokens/req avg. p95 target < 350ms. Customer flagged renewal risk if latency or unexpected cost spike (>12%).
jules-ops: Proposed run sequence: 1) reserve pool + seed KV cache (10k tokens) 2) 20m shadow at 10% 3) ramp to 100% for 45m soak 4) 30m cool-down and rollback window. I'll drop a checklist in /runbooks/dedicated/priming-orbit.md
sasha-sre: Autoscale suggestion: min_replicas=2, scale_target=0.65, max_replicas=12. Enable batching floor=8 and max_batch_ms=25ms to avoid tiny payloads. I'll stage the routing fallback to q4_0_small if p95 > 750ms for 90s.
deploy-bot: autoscale policy applied to pool-42: {"min_replicas":2,"scale_target":0.65,"max_replicas":12} :white_check_mark:
maria-cs: Load tool snippet for ops: ```./tools/loadgen --url https://dynamo.redwood/api/v1/generate --qps 110 --concurrency 20 --avg-tokens 450 --duration 3600```
raj-eng: Kicking off a small priming run on dyno-test-2 to validate cache warming. Will collect metrics: token_cost, kv_hit_rate, batch_size_hist, p95_latency, gpu_util. Logs -> s3://ops-logs/dynamo/priming-test.log
jules-ops: Dashboards to watch: customer_overview.p95, gpu.util, batch_size, kv.cache_hit, cost.rate. Abort conditions: p95 > 500ms for >3m OR gpu_util > 90% for >6m. Abort via: /ops abort or `./tools/loadgen --stop`.
sasha-sre: I'll also add a smart-router rule to shadow to quantized model if latency spikes. Fallback rule: if p95 > 800ms for 2m then route 30% to q4_0_small and notify channel.
tay-analytics: I'll produce a quick cost vs latency CSV and a small plot for the QBR. Will compute percent cost delta relative to their historical footprint and flag any >10% deltas.
maria-cs: Also want notes captured for enablement: who was on the call, what runbooks we shared, and any customer action items. Short post-run survey for Dynamo ops: 1) Were runbooks clear? 2) Is autoscale behavior acceptable? 3) Anything missing for daily ops? I'll DM their team after the soak.
raj-eng: Confirmed whitelists applied: 52.34.12.0/26 + 52.34.13.0/26. Rollback window reserved 2h after soak. Priming start in ~12m.
jules-ops: I'm on deck for the window. Will file a terse post-incident note in #postmortems with bullet takeaways.
maria-cs: Perfect. If anything deviates, tag @sasha-sre and escalate immediately. :thumbsup:
